{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Display basic info
print(penguins.info())

# Show first few rows
display(penguins.head())

# Check for missing values
print('\nMissing values by column:\n', penguins.isnull().sum())

# Check unique values in species
print('\nUnique species:', penguins['species'].unique())

# Check unique values in island
print('Unique islands:', penguins['island'].unique())

# Check unique values in sex
print('Unique sexes:', penguins['sex'].unique())"}
